Professional Summary
Motivated Frontend Engineer focused on building accessible, component-driven user interfaces using React and modern TypeScript frameworks. Comfortable contributing in Agile teams, documenting work in Confluence, and delivering reusable UI components with Storybook. Notice period: 15 days.

Technical Skills
React, TS, Next.js, CSS, Tailwind CSS, Storybook, Agile, Confluence

Frontend Engineer, Tata Consultancy Services (May 2025 - Present)
- Implemented a component library documented in Storybook and styled with Tailwind CSS and CSS, reducing UI inconsistency across projects by introducing standardized tokens and utility classes.
- Converted legacy UI pages into React + TS components for a client portal, improving render performance and maintainability; authored component usage patterns in Confluence.
- Collaborated in Agile sprints to deliver incremental features, integrating Storybook stories into CI to catch regressions early.

Frontend Engineer, Vertex Analytics (Aug 2024 - Apr 2025)
- Built interactive dashboards using React and Next.js with TS, implementing server-side rendering for key pages to improve initial load times.
- Created and maintained Storybook stories for analytic widgets, enabling cross-team reuse and faster QA cycles.
- Implemented responsive layouts using CSS and Tailwind CSS, and documented component behavior and API in Confluence as part of Agile ceremonies.
